overall: The AG found no violation: regional committee notice was posted in both Dennis and Yarmouth more than 48 hours ahead. The AG separately reminded the committee to review complaints at a meeting before responding, without a finding.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to post notice of a September 8 meeting at least 48 hours in advance.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Committee complied with its notice posting obligations under the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Not raised by the complainant: the committee delegated its response to the OML complaint to legal counsel without first reviewing it at a meeting. The AG issued a reminder only.
allegations.key_passage: The body must convene a meeting in order to review the complaint before sending a response or authorizing its legal counsel to send a response.
